name: Notification System Self-Hosted Email and Push Microservices
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted NestJS notification microservices with a unified REST API for email and push, template management, RabbitMQ queues, retry handling and monitoring; no software license fee or vendor-enforced message quota.
watch_out: Runs on your own Docker infrastructure with PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis and monitoring services. Production email needs a separately configured SMTP provider (such as SendGrid or Mailtrap), and push uses Firebase Cloud Messaging; provider charges or restrictions may apply. Change example credentials and secrets before deployment; no free hosted infrastructure or delivery allowance is included.
